name: PTR character copy: a load interrupted after the character exists is reported as copied once
contract: The target realm claims a request (state Loading) with the GUID the copy will get, then commits the copy in one transaction. If the realm stops after that commit but before it completes the request, the next poll finds the claimed request, sees the copy under the claimed GUID and completes it as copied, so the source realm reports the copy and it is not loaded a second time. ptr_character_copy_interruption after_load stops the first claimed load at that point.
